contracts.liveSeq: session.seq is the public next-event sequence number and log length. N events means seq=N, last included sequence=N-1; empty session seq=0.
contracts.projectionWatermark: restore({}, completeEvents, 0, header, inheritedEventCount).snapshot.asOfSeq is inclusive: completeEvents.length-1, including -1 for empty. restore is synchronous and only describes the supplied prefix. cachedSnapshot is not an up-to-date proof.
contracts.header: session.id derives from deeply frozen header.id; header.agentPreset is optional in SDK and must be required/equal to the owned expected preset by the caller. inheritedEventCount is a separate session/handle property, never inferred from header or defaulted when absent.
contracts.inheritedPrefix: Require safe integer 0<=inheritedEventCount<=eventCount and reject negative zero; unseeded headers require 0. Full canonical reads start at seq0 and include inherited events without offset adjustment. SDK constructor validates the fork marker relationship; projection.restore only forwards metadata and does not validate it.
contracts.readHandle: JSONL read(offset,length) slices the logical event sequence and returns {eventState,events}; every read may observe a later append. It is not a fixed snapshot; short page or EOF describes only that read. eventState is detached/shared-frozen aliasing ownership, not a count.
contracts.metadataFreshness: JSONL handle header/inheritedEventCount are captured at open. readCurrent re-reads events but does not refresh those fields; monotonic length checks detect shrink, not arbitrary same-length mutation.
contracts.stat: sessionPersistence.stat(id) exposes header, opaque revision and optional sizeBytes. Comparing before/after can detect a changed observed generation but is neither a lock nor an event count.
contracts.resume: Native resume write-opens, reads history, may append interruptedTurnClosers, prepares restored Session (may append session/end-seed), persists the unstored suffix, then runs setup under maintenance, persists setup suffix, and announces the live session/agent. Resume is not a pure read and extra lifecycle events cannot be inferred from one fixed +1 delta.
contracts.durability: Live append is synchronous; persistence observers buffer asynchronously. ctx.sessions.flush(session) is the awaited durability checkpoint, returns whether at least one listener participated, and is not a pause/append lock.

minimumCallerChecks: Bind exact owned session id, preset, cwd/header hash, inheritedEventCount and the live Session object; reject absent/invalid metadata. Preserve explicit total-page/event/byte limits, abort signal and one absolute deadline.

For a live/resumed Session, finish native setup under existing deny gates, establish the live nextSeq, await ctx.sessions.flush(session), and verify the live identity and nextSeq still match before the bounded cold read.

Page from logical offset 0; validate every seq is contiguous, every page does not exceed the requested length, and collect through explicit EOF. Restore the official inbox projection from the complete prefix with baseSeq=0 and exact handle metadata.

Require snapshot.asOfSeq===eventCount-1 and the expected projection unit. The agreed implementation uses two complete bounded sequential passes, comparing per-page seq/hash and explicit EOF, and returns a historyDigest. Any growth/change/timeout/close failure is unconfirmed, never silently truncated. This is stable observation, not an atomic snapshot.

Before accepting or mutating, synchronously recheck live Session identity/header/inheritedEventCount and live.seq===eventCount, plus current permit. Recheck after every subsequent await before a related mutation. Prefer a final synchronous check immediately adjacent to the owned synchronous mutation.
limits: No public method inspected supplies a cross-await immutable Session snapshot or compare-and-append transaction spanning the control DB and native Session. Checks establish a point-in-time matching prefix, not absence of future writes.

Read handles do not reserve write ownership. Two equal full passes strengthen content observation but do not lock the source or prove no change after the final check; the official backend contract remains append-only.
Projection asOfSeq proves only the supplied prefix, not flush success, complete billing, no model calls or future quiescence.
Provider-neutral interface declarations advertised by package.json were not present at the two exact dsh-session .d.ts paths attempted; conclusions above use shipped executable source read as text.

scope.handoffCopy: Sanitized static metadata; no host/API/model execution and not a runtime validation.
